name: Mini Hexchess
author: Dave McCooey (1997) / AGP port
description: McCooey's hexagonal chess shrunk onto 37 hexes — a 37th-birthday present for Hans Bodlaender in 1997. Each side has just a king, rook, bishop, knight and five pawns; there is no queen, no double step, no en passant and no castling, and a pawn may promote only to rook, bishop or knight.
